regions.merged_text: Archie Catellier - 28 - T. B. four yrs. ago - leaves hospital in Bat- tle Creek before cured. Early part of last month took ill again and X-ray showed trouble in both lungs cavities. Came to Monastery. En- rolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n promising weekly communion for a year and quite a number of enrollments for the PP. SS. if things turned better. X-ray then taken in Kiefer Hosp'l showed OK Oct. 30, 1935. Mother & 2 Sisters here To-day - Hospital authorities Surprised. A.C. working O.K. every day ... "cured"
